entities.name: iOS
entities.rationale: Phone icon labeled IOS at top (AWS_Icon_9 region); sender client that sends the snap to the gateway. Outside the EKS dashed box.

entities.name: Android
entities.rationale: Phone icon labeled ANDROID at top right; recipient client that receives the pushed message. Outside the EKS dashed box.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Dashed container labeled EKS that contains the GW, MEDIA, MCS, FRIEND GRAPH and SNAP DB services. Annotated with 900+ EKS clusters, 1000+ instances.

entities.name: GW
entities.rationale: Box labeled GW (gateway) drawn on the top border of the EKS dashed container; a custom gateway service built on EKS.

entities.name: Media
entities.rationale: EKS icon labeled MEDIA (AWS_Icon_6) inside the EKS dashed container; media delivery service.

entities.name: MCS
entities.rationale: EKS icon labeled MCS (AWS_Icon_7) inside the EKS dashed container; messaging core service.

entities.name: Friend Graph
entities.rationale: EKS icon labeled FRIEND GRAPH (AWS_Icon_3) inside the EKS dashed container.

entities.name: Snap DB
entities.rationale: EKS icon labeled SNAP DB (AWS_Icon_4) inside the EKS dashed container; custom database layer fronting DynamoDB.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled CLOUDFRONT (AWS_Icon_8), left of the EKS box; receives media from the Media service.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled S3 (AWS_Icon_2), below CloudFront; persists snap media.

entities.name: ElastiCache
entities.rationale: Blue icon labeled ELASTICACHE (AWS_Icon_5), right of the EKS box; stores connection/server ID metadata looked up by MCS.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue icon labeled DYNAMODB (AWS_Icon_1), below the EKS box; stores metadata behind Snap DB. Annotated 400TB, 2B+ rows/min.

visual_connections.description: Pink arrow from the iOS phone down to the GW box; the app sends the snap through the gateway.
Pink arrow from GW down to the MEDIA service.
Pink arrow from GW down to the MCS service.
Pink arrow from MEDIA leftwards to CloudFront; media is sent to CloudFront.
Pink arrow from CloudFront down to S3; media persisted in S3.
Pink arrow from MCS rightwards to ElastiCache; lookup of connection/server ID.
Pink arrow from MCS curving down-left to FRIEND GRAPH.
Pink arrow from MCS down to SNAP DB.
Pink arrow from SNAP DB down out of the EKS box to DynamoDB; metadata stored in DynamoDB.
Pink arrow from MCS up past the GW to the Android phone; message pushed to the recipient over the persistent connection.
